drafted_from: tool:read-saved-service-watches's own row and test/service-watch.test.mjs, whose runs answered the values shown here
start_here: Say to your AI: "Show me the saved usage watch called usage and its latest reading." It runs tool:read-saved-service-watches { watch_id: "usage" } and contacts no provider.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads the service-watch records tool:keep-service-usage-watches saved and writes nothing.
instructions: 1. Name the watch (watch_id), or leave it out to read every saved watch.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-saved-service-watches and { watch_id }.
3. Read watches: each has its latest run_key, reading (read with usage, or unread with a reason), pending command and next due time.
4. The old service-wide tool:read-service-watch is a different identity; use this tool for account-owned watches.
